purpose: Fix the deterministic public-resource representation mismatch in the existing E10e/E10g evidence-family counter: concrete public GET paths equivalent to already-accepted frozen route templates must count as the same evidence family without lowering any evidence threshold.

records: E14c sanitized E10g handoff evidence diagnostic
E14c sanitized E10g handoff evidence-shape diagnostic
root_cause_source.interpretation: All three E10g handoff blocks attributed to fewer than two visible public evidence markers satisfy the unchanged threshold when concrete public GET paths are mapped to their equivalent frozen public route families. The threshold itself is not implicated and must remain unchanged.

candidate_change.name: public_get_evidence_family_comparison_canonicalization
requirements: derive accepted evidence families from the existing E10e CONCRETE_EVIDENCE_MARKERS and the frozen research/e2/tool_registry.py read declarations
count a concrete public GET path as the same family as its equivalent already-accepted canonical template
do not add any new evidence family beyond the existing E10e marker set
do not lower the E10g human-handoff minimum of two distinct public evidence families
do not lower E10e state-change evidence requirements
reject unrelated routes, wrong HTTP methods, longer route suffixes, and ambiguous shapes
preserve stored model evidence_plan text unchanged

full_remeasurement_condition: Only a complete E14d DEV run that passes every unchanged private-scoring threshold may authorize a measurement-only DEV+VALIDATION rerun. VALIDATION remains forbidden for tuning.
